description: React component for a searchable user list with pagination, filtering, and internationalization support in Mattermost.

classes.name: SearchableUserList
classes.description: A React component that displays a list of users with search and pagination features.

methods.name: scrollToTop
methods.description: Scrolls the user list to the top.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method that focuses the search bar on mount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Scrolls to top when page or search term changes.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the next page.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to the previous page.

methods.name: focusSearchBar
methods.description: Focuses the search input if focusOnMount is true.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Handles input change in the search box.

methods.name: renderCount
methods.description: Renders the count of users displayed.
